Class InputManager

java.lang.Object
com.r3m.spaceshooter.system.InputManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
KeyListener, EventListener
public class InputManager extends Object implements KeyListener
Tracks movement keys and queues numeric menu choices from keyboard events.
